minimal_truthful_patch.change: Add explicit --repo-root argument (absolute_path-validated, mirroring Snapshot) to BootstrapCommand::Brief and pass it to capture_snapshot; remove std::env::current_dir() fallback entirely.

Replace min_by_key(code) reason selection with a required designated gap reason: resolve a named constant code (e.g., BRIEF_SCOPE_EXCLUDED) from the registry and return BootstrapCompileError::ContractChallenge when absent, so exclusion semantics are intentional rather than lexicographic.

Preserve error typing to the process boundary: map BootstrapCompileError variants and IO/decode failures to distinct typed JSON error documents with distinct exit codes (success stays exit 0 + single pretty JSON artifact on stdout), instead of collapsing into anyhow strings.
